SELECT l.sample_no AS sampleNo, l.batch_no AS batchNo, l.material_name AS materialName, l.material_code AS materialCode, l.material_spec AS materialSpec, l.quantity, l.unit_id AS unitId, l.observation_result AS observationResult, l.observation_remark AS observationRemark, l.observer_id AS observerId, l.observation_time AS observationTime FROM lm_retention_observation_ledger l WHERE 1=1
AND l.material_id IN
#{materialId}
AND l.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND l.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND l.observation_time >= CONCAT(#{observationStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND l.observation_time <= CONCAT(#{observationEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY l.observation_time DESC
